title: Stale Price Oracle Data Vulnerability
text:
Stale Oracle Price Data Vulnerability in Solana DeFi

Description:
Programs that use price oracles (Pyth, Switchboard, Chainlink) without
checking data freshness are vulnerable to stale price attacks.

Vulnerable pattern:
```rust
let price_account = &ctx.accounts.price_feed;
let price_data = price_account.try_borrow_data()?;
let price = parse_price(&price_data);  // No staleness check!
// Use stale price for liquidation/swap
```

Attack vector:
- Oracle stops updating (network issues, manipulation)
- Price becomes stale (hours old)
- Attacker exploits difference between stale and real price
- Liquidations at wrong price, arbitrage opportunities

Secure pattern:
```rust
use pyth_sdk_solana::load_price_feed_from_account_info;

let price_feed = load_price_feed_from_account_info(&ctx.accounts.price_feed)?;
let current_time = Clock::get()?.unix_timestamp;
let price = price_feed.get_price_no_older_than(current_time, 60)?; // Max 60s old

require!(price.is_some(), ErrorCode::StalePriceData);
```

Detection: Look for price oracle accounts without timestamp/age validation.
Affected protocols: Mango Markets, Solend, Marginfi, any DeFi using oracles.
Source: Mango Markets exploit 2022, Oracle manipulation research
